name: amp-thread-launcher
title: Amp
description: Start Amp threads on a runner or in an orb with your chosen mode and project.
author: charlieyou

commands.name: new-thread
commands.title: Start Amp Thread
commands.description: Submit a prompt to Amp with a runner, project, and agent mode.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Amp API Key
preferences.description: Optional if already signed in to Amp on this Mac. Otherwise, enter an access token from ampcode.com/settings/security.

preferences.name: defaultRunnerId
preferences.title: Default Runner ID
preferences.description: Runner ID from Amp. You can override it for each thread.
